about.title: Opportunity should not depend on who you know
about.intro: EVENTIFY started because the best competitions, workshops and internships were buried in group chats. We put them in one place and match them to what each student can actually do.
about.valuesSubtitle: They decide what we build, and just as often what we refuse to build.
about.value1Desc: A first-year student and a final-year student see the same opportunities. Matching is based on skills, not on which club you joined.
about.value2Desc: Every match score explains itself. If you scored 62%, you can see which requirement pulled it down and what to learn next.
about.value3Desc: Organizations are reviewed before they can post. No expired listings, no dead links, no opportunities that quietly never existed.
about.storyTitle: Built by students who kept missing deadlines
about.storyP1: EVENTIFY began as a graduation project in Amman, after its founders missed a hackathon deadline that had only ever been announced in a group chat they were not in.
about.storyP2: The first version was a shared spreadsheet of every competition the team could find. It spread across three universities in one semester — which made the real problem obvious: the opportunities existed, but nobody could see the ones that fit them.
about.storyP3: Today EVENTIFY brings competitions, workshops, courses and internships into one verified feed, and Rafeeq — our AI companion — ranks them against the profile you build once.

legal.privacyIntro: What we collect, why we collect it, and what you can do about it — in plain language.
legal.termsIntro: The rules for using EVENTIFY, for students and for the organizations publishing on it.

privacy.p1: Two kinds of data. First, what you give us: your name, email, university or organization, the skills on your profile, the files you attach to an application, and the messages you send us. Second, what your use of the platform produces: which opportunities you open, save and apply to, and the match scores generated from your profile.
privacy.p2li1: To match you with opportunities. Without your skills and level, a match score is meaningless.
privacy.p2li2: To pass your application to the organization you applied to. They see the profile and files you submitted, nothing else.
privacy.p2li3: To notify you before a deadline closes on something you saved.
privacy.p2li4: To review organizations before they can publish, which is how listings stay real.
privacy.p3: We do not sell your data. We do not pass your profile to organizations you have not applied to. We do not use the content of your applications to train models.
privacy.p4: Your public profile is visible to other EVENTIFY users and to verified organizations. Your email, phone number and attached files are shared only with an organization you have applied to, and only after you submit that application.
privacy.p5: Application records stay for as long as your account is open, so you can see your own history. Delete your account and the profile, files and application history are removed within 30 days. Aggregate counts that cannot identify you — such as how many people applied to an event — remain with the organization.
privacy.p6li1: Edit or remove anything on your profile at any time from your settings.
privacy.p6li2: Request a copy of your data, or its deletion, by writing to hello@eventify.io.
privacy.p6li3: Turn deadline and status notifications off without closing your account.
privacy.p7: We use one functional cookie to keep you signed in and a local preference for your light or dark theme. No advertising or cross-site tracking cookies are set.
privacy.p8: Write to hello@eventify.io or use the
privacy.p8b: We answer within one working day.

terms.p1: Anyone aged 16 or over can create a student account. Organization accounts are created by someone authorized to represent that organization, and are usable only after our review team verifies it.
terms.p2: Keep your password to yourself and your profile accurate. You are responsible for what happens under your account. Applications submitted from your account are treated as submitted by you.
terms.p3li1: Represent your own skills and history honestly. Fabricated profiles get suspended.
terms.p3li2: Do not submit someone else's work, CV or certificates as your own.
terms.p3li3: Do not scrape, resell or republish listings from the platform.
terms.p4li1: Publish only opportunities that exist, with accurate dates, requirements and prizes.
terms.p4li2: Use applicant data solely to assess that application.
terms.p4li3: Charging students to apply is not permitted, and neither is asking for payment details on EVENTIFY.
terms.p5: Every opportunity is reviewed before it goes live. We can decline or remove a listing that is incomplete, misleading or unsafe, and we can suspend an account that breaks these terms. Where the situation allows it, we tell you why and how to appeal.
terms.p6: You keep ownership of everything you upload. You give us permission to display it on EVENTIFY for the purpose you uploaded it for — a profile shown to organizations you applied to, or a listing shown to students.
terms.p7: We connect students and organizations. We do not run the events themselves and cannot guarantee an outcome, a prize, a placement or the conduct of an organizer. Match scores are a ranking aid, not a promise.
terms.p8: If these terms change materially, we notify account holders before the change takes effect. Continuing to use EVENTIFY after that date means the new terms apply.
terms.p9: Questions about these terms go to hello@eventify.io.
